items.name: Rocky road
items.description: A no-bake chocolate bar packed with marshmallows, biscuit pieces and sometimes nuts or cherries.

items.name: Millionaire's shortbread
items.description: Three layers: buttery shortbread, soft caramel and a chocolate top. Sometimes called caramel shortbread.

items.name: Scone (with jam and cream)
items.description: A small, round baked cake, split and served with jam and clotted cream. The classic cream tea.

items.name: Chocolate muffin
items.description: A large, soft individual cake baked in a paper case, with a domed top and chocolate chips or cocoa.

items.name: Flapjack
items.description: A chewy oat bar made with butter, sugar and golden syrup. Cut into squares or rectangles.

items.name: Chocolate brownie
items.description: A dense, rich chocolate square. Fudgy in the middle with a thin crackly top.

items.name: Chocolate chip cookie
items.description: A round, flat biscuit with pieces of chocolate baked into it. Soft or crunchy.

items.name: Cupcake
items.description: A small sponge cake in a paper case, topped with a swirl of buttercream or icing and decorations.

items.name: Victoria sandwich
items.description: Two layers of light sponge with jam and cream in the middle, dusted with sugar on top. Also called a Victoria sponge.

items.name: Lemon drizzle cake
items.description: A lemon sponge loaf soaked with a sweet, tangy lemon syrup while still warm, giving it a crisp sugary top.

items.name: Carrot cake
items.description: A moist, spiced sponge made with grated carrot, usually with a cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Chocolate fudge cake
items.description: A layered chocolate sponge covered in thick, fudgy chocolate icing.

items.name: Croissant
items.description: A crescent-shaped French pastry made from layers of buttery, flaky dough.

items.name: Almond croissant
items.description: A croissant filled with sweet almond paste, topped with flaked almonds and icing sugar.

items.name: Cinnamon bun or roll
items.description: A soft, sweet dough rolled up in a spiral with a cinnamon and sugar filling, often glazed or iced.

items.name: Pain au chocolat
items.audioSsml: <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="pæn əʊ ˈʃɒkəlɑː">pain au chocolat</phoneme>
items.description: A rectangular flaky pastry, like a croissant, with sticks of dark chocolate baked inside.

items.name: Cornish pasty
items.description: A D-shaped pastry with a crimped edge, filled with beef, potato, swede and onion. Eaten hot or cold.

items.name: Cheese and onion slice
items.description: A rectangle of puff pastry with a savoury cheese and onion filling.

items.name: Toasted teacake
items.description: A round, lightly sweet bread roll with dried fruit, split, toasted and served with butter.

items.name: Sausage roll
items.description: Seasoned sausage meat wrapped in golden puff pastry. A savoury snack served hot or cold.
